products.post_content:
The Brushed Aluminum Voice and Telephone Information Panel is an appearance variant for projects requiring coordinated low-voltage information connection points. It can be considered for hotel rooms, serviced apartments, offices, and other interiors where voice or telephone-related interfaces need to match a brushed metal panel series.

The exact connector type, wiring standard, signal compatibility, and regional requirements are not confirmed in the source material. These details must be reviewed during project selection rather than inferred from the product appearance.

Key Features

  • Brushed aluminum appearance for coordinated project interiors
  • Panel format for voice, telephone, or information connection planning
  • Suitable for hotel rooms, apartments, and office projects
  • Can be coordinated with other Brushed Aluminum Series panels
  • Provides an appearance variant of an existing functional product type
  • Supports OEM/ODM labeling, packaging, and project matching discussion

Application Scenarios

  • Hotel guest room information connection points
  • Serviced apartment low-voltage installations
  • Office and meeting-room projects
  • Coordinated brushed metal panel packages
  • OEM/ODM hotel panel programs

B2B Project Value

  • Provides a brushed aluminum option for coordinated room panel schedules
  • Helps contractors align low-voltage connection points with the selected finish
  • Expands distributor offerings without claiming a different unverified interface standard
  • Supports project-specific labeling and connector confirmation

OEM / ODM Project Support
